description:
Receiver code, scalar evaluation results and acquisition/preparation adapters for sparse UAV consumed-energy recovery. Evaluation reuses 247 AMOVFLY records and 161 windows of one AtlantikSolar flight. Original dense flight data, trajectories, feature arrays and checkpoints are excluded.

The sparse counters, measurement drift and erasures are imposed replay mechanisms. No hardware or SITL validation is claimed. The historical HGB raw-to-feature adapter is incomplete. The verified electrical replay and aggregate checks remain separate from that retained negative control.
